stem.text: A particle of mass $m$, travelling with speed $u$, collides with a stationary particle of mass $M$. The velocities of the two particles before and after the collision are shown.

stem.alt: Two particles on a dashed horizontal line. The left particle is labelled m and has an arrow labelled u pointing right towards the particle labelled M on the right. Caption: before collision.

Particle labelled M moving up and to the right at an angle alpha above a dashed horizontal line, with a velocity arrow labelled u over 3. Particle labelled m moving down and to the right at an angle beta below the line, with a velocity arrow labelled u over 2. Caption: after collision.

stem.text: Which vector diagram correctly shows the momenta before and after the collision?

A.alt: Vector diagram: a horizontal arrow labelled mu, a second arrow labelled mu over 2 and a third arrow labelled Mu over 3 forming a triangle, with angles alpha and beta marked at the corners.
